title: Evidence pack directory contract
description: Pack-level descriptor. NOT a JSON Schema for a single document; it describes which files must exist in an evidence pack directory and which JSON Schema (if any) each file conforms to. Read by eval_engine.validate_pack.

manifest.json.purpose: Run identity, environment fingerprint, command, fixture or benchmark-manifest hash, file list.

validation_summary.json.purpose: Per-gate status roll-up and overall verdict.

runtime_profile.json.purpose: Wall-clock timing and host environment snapshot.

cost_profile.json.purpose: Measured + self-reported cost and envelope evaluation.

integrity_check.json.purpose: Static integrity findings for the skill directory.

agent_run_trace.jsonl.purpose: Process and optional LLM trace; one JSON record per line.

environment.lock.purpose: pip-freeze snapshot for the runner's Python environment.

output.json.purpose: Parsed skill output. Absent when the skill failed before producing output.

provenance.json.purpose: Host GPU/CUDA identity and before/after deltas for declared side-effect paths. Written by full-run packs; absent on preflight-only packs.

llm_interaction.json.purpose: LLM-mediated packs only. Backend, model, prompts, and token accounting.

dataset_run.jsonl.purpose: Benchmark packs only. One record per case.

skill_run/.purpose: LLM-mediated packs may nest a deterministic skill run pack here.

drift_report.md.purpose: Optional drift comparison written by eval_engine.diff_runs.

trust_summary.json.purpose: Trusted-run summary (skill pack + paired-verifier packs). Written by the trusted-run path; not present in unverified packs.

arms/with_skill.json.purpose: Paired-eval with-skill arm response, parsed payload, and assertion results.

arms/without_skill.json.purpose: Paired-eval without-skill arm response, parsed payload, and assertion results.

paired_eval.md.purpose: Human-readable paired with-skill / without-skill comparison report.

versioning_policy.additive_minor: New optional files, new optional fields, new gate values.
versioning_policy.breaking_major: Removing/renaming files, removing required fields, changing the meaning of an existing status value.
versioning_policy.missing_version: Packs without pack_format_version are pre-1.0 and may not satisfy this descriptor.
